reuse.why: Extends the existing recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds shared holiday predicates in shared/schedules.ts, but getDatesInRange re-assembles the occurrence pipeline of getUpcomingDates instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The take-extra/filter(isSkippedDailyOccurrence)/slice pattern is repeated in getNextDate (twice), getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and getDatesInRange copies getUpcomingDates' RSchedule/skipWeekend-ternary/breadcrumb scaffold.

placement.why: Holiday rules live in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend logic and the handler sits in server/schedules/app.ts; the daily skip rule is however split between the rrule builder (weekends) and post-filters at each consumer (holidays).

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (daily skip, range handler, holidays, yearly holidays) plus tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The daily-skip rule now has two mechanisms (byDayOfWeek in the rrule and a per-consumer holiday filter with a holidays.length lookahead heuristic), and each consumer must remember to apply the filter, which is fragile to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts decides `shiftsWeekend = config.skipWeekend && config.frequency !== 'daily'` itself instead of relying on getDateWithSkippedWeekend/the shared skip predicates like getUpcomingDates does.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates' occurrence chain (renamed condition shiftsWeekend, range bounds instead of take) and the extra-take/filter/slice holiday pattern is repeated inline in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a `holidays` parameter; recurConfigToRSchedule gains a daily skipWeekend branch; getDatesInRange computes its own daily/non-daily shiftsWeekend switch around the helper.
